svg.title: Rapamycin-type drugs in aging: the randomized human trials
svg.desc: Rapamycin-type drugs in aging: the randomized human trials. RTB101 phase 3, 2021 (related drug), 1024 people: Main goal not met. RTB101 phase 2b, 2021 (related drug), 652 people: First analysis missed; pooled analysis hit. Phase 2a, 2018 (two related drugs), 264 people: Fewer infections reported. PEARL, 2025 (registry count), 129 people: Main goal not met; some gains in women. RAPA-EX-01, 2026, 40 people: No benefit; may blunt exercise gains. Topical skin cream, 2019, 36 people: Skin aging markers improved. Older-adult safety pilot, 2018, 25 people: No clear changes; red-cell dips.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2,170 people in seven trials. The three largest tested related mTOR drugs, not rapamycin itself.
